dog.description_text:
My #BoroughBreak Buddy Writes: James was excellently behaved throughout the whole walk. We were out from around 11am to 3pm, walking nearly the entire time from East River to the Hudson. He enjoyed exploring the parks and had really excellent leash manners. Occasionally he would tug to be interested in a human, and he kept to himself around other dogs. He loved his pup cup! He would not "sit" but whenever I sat, he would put his front paws on me like he was hugging me. He also like to put his front paws on me when I was standing still.

What my friends at ACC say about me:

My history is a mystery and my friends here do not know much about me yet!

It is unknown if I have ever lived with other animals or children.

I would do best in a home without very tiny humans, although I could be open to older human children once I meet them.

I prefer to call the shots and enjoy coming to you when I'm ready for pets.
dog.name: James
